list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The single Yb(II) center binds one nitrogen atom and one η6-coordinated arene from each amidinate fragment, producing a bent bis(arene) arrangement; one THF molecule also coordinates to Yb.

synthesis.procedure: Under the article's air- and moisture-excluding conditions, a toluene solution of Yb[N(SiMe3)2]2(THF)2 was added to a toluene solution of L1H and stirred overnight at ambient temperature. Volatiles were removed under vacuum and the residue was recrystallized from THF/hexane.
synthesis.time: overnight (approximately 12 h in Results and discussion)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation under vacuum; recrystallization from THF/hexane (1:1) gave dark-red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The octahedral Yb(III) center binds two iodides, two THF oxygen atoms, and the two nitrogens of one chelating amidinate fragment. The other amidinate fragment is protonated to a non-coordinating amidine.

synthesis.procedure: Under the article's air- and moisture-excluding conditions, a toluene solution of iodine was added to a toluene solution of 1. The mixture was stirred overnight, volatiles were removed under vacuum, and the residue was recrystallized from THF/hexane.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Removal of volatiles under vacuum followed by recrystallization from THF/hexane gave red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete ate-complex contains one La(III) and two Li centers. La binds four nitrogens of the chelating ansa-bis(amidinate) and three bridging chlorides. One Li is linked to La through two chlorides and binds two THF molecules; the other binds a bridging chloride, two amidinate nitrogens, and one THF.

synthesis.procedure: Under the article's air- and moisture-excluding conditions, n-BuLi in hexane was added at 0 °C to L1H in diethyl ether. After stirring for 1 h and warming to room temperature, volatiles were removed. The residue was dissolved in THF and added to a LaCl3 suspension in THF. The mixture was stirred at 65 °C for 8 h, filtered, concentrated, extracted with toluene, and crystallized from THF/hexane.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C during lithiation; then room temperature; 65 °C for the LaCl3 reaction
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques; in situ lithiation followed by salt metathesis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration and solvent removal under vacuum, toluene extraction and filtration, then slow condensation of hexane into a THF solution gave light-yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three La centers form a La3Cl5 core linked by three μ2- and two μ3-bridging chlorides. One La binds the four nitrogens of an ansa-bis(amidinate), while each other La binds a monoanionic chelating amidinate and one THF. The crystal contains 0.5 toluene and 1.5 diethyl ether molecules per complex.

synthesis.procedure: The procedure was similar to that for 3: L2H was lithiated with n-BuLi in diethyl ether, then reacted with LaCl3 in THF. The reaction mixture was refluxed for 120 h until LaCl3 dissolved. The shared workup included solvent removal and toluene extraction; the product was recrystallized from diethyl ether.
synthesis.time: 120 h reflux; lithiation follows the shared procedure for 3
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques; in situ lithiation followed by salt metathesis
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Shared solvent-removal and toluene-extraction workup, followed by recrystallization from diethyl ether, gave pale-yellow crystals.
